description: Modular, type-safe GraphQL for TypeScript. Each module owns its SDL, resolvers and middleware, olio() composes them into one graphql 16 schema, and codegen types every builder.
rules: Use graphql 16, never 17: it is a peer dependency.
A module resolves only the fields its own SDL declares; extend another module's type in your module's SDL to add fields to it.
Write resolvers with the builders (query.<id>, mutation.<id>, resolvers.<id>.<Type>) or inline in module.<id>({ resolvers }), so they are type-checked.
Rerun codegen after every SDL change and never edit generated.ts by hand.
Load files with loaders(import.meta.dirname) from @nxara/olio-tools, with patterns like "typedefs/*.gql" and "query.{js,ts}".
Throw a GraphQLError for errors clients should see; anything else reaches them as "Unexpected error.".
Declare the registered ctx with type or inline, not interface.
